title: W-COMM-001 is fully live
summary: For the first time, institutional communication can be written once, published in EN/DE/PT, and cryptographically verifiable by anyone.
body:
Today we reached a meaningful milestone.

W-COMM-001 is fully live.

For the first time, institutional communication can be:
– Written once
– Published in EN / DE / PT
– Cryptographically verifiable by anyone

Each communication is no longer just a message.
It becomes a verifiable artifact.

What this means in practice:

• A public verify page for every communication
• Clear separation between content, proof, and guarantee
• Multilingual consistency without fragmentation
• A new standard: don't trust the message — verify it

Live stack:

– /prove/ → Trilingual landing
– /desktop/?auto=live → Live demo
– /comm/generate-multilang → EN + DE + PT generation
– /comm/{id}/verify → Public verification
– /comm/{id}/render → Channel-ready outputs

This is not about publishing faster.

This is about restoring integrity in communication
in a world saturated with unverifiable content.

We believe the future of institutional messaging is:

→ Verifiable
→ Traceable
→ Sovereign

And this is just the beginning.
